decision: The MDL is checked against indicative ranges per discipline for a 1x1 H-class CCGT EPC with the power island supplied by the consortium member (records mdl_benchmark): below the minimum = WARN (scope probably missing), above the maximum = INFO (review for duplication).
rationale: An at-least-one-document coverage check reported the Rev A MDL (623 documents, 49,000 h) as complete although it missed about three quarters of the work; quantities need an independent plausibility check. The ranges are engineering judgement from comparable plants, not contractual figures, and are refined with the company historical data when available.
title: MDL completeness benchmarks (indicative quantities per discipline)
